skill.name: performance-analyzer
skill.description: Analyze influencer campaign performance against targets, benchmarks, platforms, creators, content, engagement quality, and attribution. It prepares ranked learnings and recommendations, but it does not calculate dollar-level ROI.
skill.summary: Analyze influencer campaign results and turn metrics into ranked learnings.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown links, code fences, placeholder notation, and fixed memory paths. The confirmed risks are the optional YouTube connector command and its use of YOUTUBE_API_KEY. No prompt injection or malicious data-exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.suggestion: State that the connector is optional and should run only after user confirmation. Keep the script path fixed and pass handles as arguments.
Document that YOUTUBE_API_KEY is read only for YouTube API calls and must never be printed, stored, or included in reports.

remediation.issue: Relative repository links trigger traversal warnings
remediation.suggestion: Prefer package-local links where possible, and explain that shared references stay inside the repository documentation tree.

content.value_statement: Influencer campaign results are hard to compare across platforms, creators, and content formats. This skill turns campaign metrics into scorecards, rankings, attribution notes, and recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Builds scorecards for reach, impressions, engagement, clicks, conversions, revenue, and targets.
Ranks platforms, creators, and content formats using campaign metrics and benchmarks.
Analyzes engagement quality, comment sentiment, and purchase-intent signals.
Breaks down conversion attribution by promo code, UTM, direct, and estimated influence.
Generates top learnings, roster recommendations, and next campaign guidance.
Can use a documented YouTube connector for measured video views, likes, and comments.
limitations: Quality depends on the campaign exports, screenshots, analytics, and sales data provided.
It does not calculate dollar-level ROI or payback math; use the ROI calculator for that.
Connector use may require local scripts, user confirmation, and a YouTube API key.
Statistical winner claims require enough sample size and the documented significance check.

use_cases.title: Post-campaign readout
use_cases.description: Compare actual results against targets and benchmarks after an influencer campaign ends.

use_cases.title: Creator renewal decisions
use_cases.description: Rank creators by performance, diagnose weak results, and decide who should renew or change scope.

use_cases.title: Channel and content optimization
use_cases.description: Find the platforms, formats, hooks, and messages that produced the strongest measurable outcomes.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze one campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze performance for our [campaign name] influencer campaign. I have reach, engagement, clicks, conversions, revenue, and creator reports.

prompt_templates.title: Compare creators
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these creators for [campaign name]: [handles]. Rank them by reach, engagement quality, conversions, and renewal recommendation.

prompt_templates.title: Find winning content
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze content performance for [campaign name]. Compare platforms, formats, hooks, themes, and calls to action against campaign benchmarks.

prompt_templates.title: Build attribution readout
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a conversion and attribution analysis for [campaign name]. Use promo codes, UTM data, direct attribution, estimated influence, and campaign targets.

output_examples.input: Analyze our summer skincare campaign with ten creators across Instagram and TikTok.
output_examples.output: A campaign scorecard with target comparisons, platform ranking, top three creators, conversion attribution, key learning, and renewal recommendations.

output_examples.input: Compare @creatorA, @creatorB, and @creatorC for our product launch.
output_examples.output: A creator ranking that explains reach, engagement quality, conversion impact, content patterns, underperformance causes, and next partnership actions.

output_examples.input: Find what content worked best in our YouTube influencer campaign.
output_examples.output: A content performance readout covering views, likes, comments, engagement quality, winning hooks, strong formats, and future campaign recommendations.

best_practices: Provide campaign dates, targets, benchmarks, creator handles, platform metrics, and conversion sources before analysis.
Label each metric source as measured, creator-provided, or estimated so confidence is clear.
Use significance checks before declaring a platform, creator, or format as a proven winner.
anti_patterns: Do not treat screenshots, rounded platform numbers, and API exports as identical sources.
Do not ask this skill to calculate final ROI or payback math.
Do not renew or drop creators based only on reach without conversion and engagement quality context.

faq.question: What data should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide campaign dates, creators, platforms, reach, impressions, engagement, clicks, conversions, revenue, promo codes, and any target benchmarks.

faq.question: Can it compare creators in one campaign?
faq.answer: Yes. It ranks creators and explains performance using reach, engagement, conversions, content quality, and renewal fit.

faq.question: Does it calculate ROI?
faq.answer: No. It prepares performance and attribution inputs. Use the ROI calculator for dollar-level return and payback analysis.

faq.question: Can it use live platform data?
faq.answer: It usually works from pasted exports and reports. A documented YouTube connector can pull measured video metrics when configured.

faq.question: How does it handle weak data?
faq.answer: It asks for missing inputs, labels estimates clearly, and avoids strong winner claims without enough evidence.

faq.question: Who is this skill for?
faq.answer: It is for marketers, agencies, and analysts who review influencer campaign results and plan future investments.
